sentences.text: THE ABOVE MFA AND MFA-CROB ARE COMING ON FOR HEARING/ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:

JUDGMENT Smt. H.R. Renuka, learned counsel appearing for the KSRTC and Sri.Mahesh Kaje, learned counsel appearing for the claimant are present before the Court and submit that, the parties have agreed to settle the cases for compensation of Rs.8,30,652/- with interest at 6% per annum from the date of petition till the date of deposit.
and hence, this appeal and Cross-objection may kindly be disposed of.
In support of their submission, the learned counsels appearing for the parties have also filed a joint memo duly MFA No. 6632 of 2015 C/W signed by them.

The joint memo is placed on record and it reads as under:
"JOINT MEMO
The appellant and the first respondent have agreed to settle the above cases.

Consequently, the judgment and award dated 27.03.2015 in MVC No.202/2013 passed by the Addl. Senior Civil Judge and Member MACT, Puttur,
D.K. under challenge in the above cases may kindly be modified as under:
"The first respondent-claimant is entitled for compensation of Rs.8,30,652/- with interest at 6% pa., from the date of petition till the date of deposit."
The first respondent has agreed to accept the compensation as modified above in full and final settlement of all his claims in MVC No.202/2013 and the Corporation has agreed to pay the amount stated above."

sentences.text: In view of the joint memo, these appeal and Cross- objection are disposed of.
The Registry is directed to draw the award in terms of the joint memo.
MFA No. 6632 of 2015 C/W

Considering the nature of injuries suffered by the respondent/claimant,
the entire compensation amount with accrued interest as stated in Joint Memo for the period from the date of petition till the date of deposit, is ordered to be released in favour of the Respondent/Cross- objector/claimant.
The amount in deposit before this Court is ordered to be transmitted to the concerned Tribunal forthwith.
The Appellant/Corporation is directed to deposit the entire compensation amount with accrued interest, within four weeks from today.

Sd/-
